newsitem.title: USA: Meritage acquires Wendy's franchise stake.
newsitem.headline: Meritage acquires Wendy's franchise stake.

text.p: Meritage Hospitality Group said it has successfully completed a cash tender offer to acquire a majority interest in the Wendy's of West Michigan Limited Partnership.
The partnership operates 26 Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburgers restaurants in western Michigan under a franchise agreement with Wendy's International Inc.

Meritage President Christopher Hewitt said in a statement that the tender offer, which expired October 31, advances the company's objectives of acquiring hospitality-related businesses with "substantial growth potential."
Meritage currently owns three full-service hotels in Michigan and the Grand Haven Harbor Yacht Club in Grand Haven, Mich.
